HOW I WORK

Strategy when you need direction.
Delivery when you need results.

I'm Marnie. I work with small businesses, founders and independent clients who need more than a list of suggestions. Sometimes the right starting point is research or a clear plan. Sometimes something needs untangling, building or fixing. I can work out the direction and take responsibility for the practical work that follows.

I've managed ecommerce catalogues containing 5,000+ products, built websites from front to back, created Shopify apps and worked across Shopify, Etsy, TikTok Shop and Amazon. I've also developed brands, supported marketing campaigns and publishing projects, researched commercial ideas and turned complicated projects into workable plans. That breadth matters when a problem doesn't fit neatly into one category.

I don't separate strategy from delivery. If I recommend something, I'm thinking about how it will work in practice, what it will cost in time and resources, what could go wrong and whether it makes commercial sense. You'll deal directly with the person doing the work: me.

CLEAR, SENSIBLE PRICING

Small jobs welcome.
Bigger projects quoted properly.

A small job shouldn't require an agency-sized budget, and a full project shouldn't be squeezed into a small-task price. These are starting points for clearly defined work. I'll explain the scope, deliverables and cost before we begin.

VA & ADMIN SUPPORT£35/hour
ECOMMERCE & PROJECT SUPPORT£40/hour
STRATEGY & RESEARCH£45/hour
WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT£50/hour

Fixed-price work is quoted by scope, not simply by the hour. Specialist and ongoing projects can be quoted individually. Hosting, paid apps and third-party services are separate where applicable.

WHAT WORKING WITH ME IS LIKE

I speak normal.

I communicate professionally without turning a simple conversation into a board meeting. I'll ask questions when I need to, keep you updated and tell you if there's a problem.

No unnecessary jargon. No agency waffle. No pretending something is complicated just to sound clever.

I work independently and don't need every step spoon-fed to me. Give me the objective, the information I need and room to work. If I don't know something, I'll say so. Then I'll research it.

YOUR PROJECT COULD BE NEXT

Got something that needs sorting?

You don't need to arrive with a perfect brief or know which service to choose. Tell me what you're trying to achieve, what's getting in the way and what you've already tried. I'll ask the right questions, tell you whether I can help and explain the sensible next step — including the cost — before we go any further.
